introduction:
On today's episode of "How does stuff actually work?™": Touchscreens 

#kurzgesagt
#inanutshell #kur

vocabulary.definition: having the property of conducting heat or electricity
vocabulary.example: The wires in the touchscreen are made of conductive material.

vocabulary.definition: to change the shape or appearance of something
vocabulary.example: The fingertip distorts the electric fields when touching the screen.

vocabulary.definition: points where two or more things intersect or cross each other
vocabulary.example: The touchscreen works by detecting intersections of horizontal and vertical threads.
The touchscreen's grid is invisible to the naked eye.

vocabulary.definition: the action of making the best or most effective use of a situation or resource
vocabulary.example: The touchscreen technology underwent optimization to improve its functionality.

vocabulary.definition: a young child who is just beginning to walk
vocabulary.example: Toddlers nowadays learn to swipe screens before they learn to talk.
